# sovereign.wiki

> The sovereign data moat — open-source and science, eaten daily, fed to the hives.

## What this is
- 530 crown-jewel MCP packages on PyPI (`pip install meok-cj-<name>`) — each with agent-card.json, llms.txt, mcp.json, MCP+A2A+HTTP+Sigil protocols, Ed25519 attestation
- The AI Governance Map: SOV3/OOWM apex → 12 Generals BFT council (7/12 quorum) → 15 regulatory frameworks → 28 hives → Layer 0
- 12 sovereign brain configs: King, Queen, Quant, Man, OOWM, MOM, Small MoE, Big MoE, Bridge, Council, Sovereign, Free
- Daily ingestion engine (04:00 UTC): GitHub awesome-lists + arXiv CS.AI/CS.LG + open government data → SOV3 memory → OLM brain → Sigil ledger → town feed → this catalog

## Ecosystem
- CSOAI (AI safety / EU AI Act / ISO 42001): https://csoai.org
- Council of AI (33-agent BFT Council): https://councilof.ai
- MEOK (sovereign AI compliance infrastructure): https://meok.ai
- ProofOf.AI (attestation & notary): https://proofof.ai

## Machine endpoints
- Agent card: /.well-known/agent-card.json
- This file: /llms.txt
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
- Robots: /robots.txt

## Principles
Sovereign by design — audit-grade, signed, neutral. Measurement credentials, never certification theatre. UK-sovereign, AUKUS-compatible.
